name: estudos-odonto
description: Plataforma inteligente de estudos de Odontologia

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/emulators.mjs exec "npm run test:integration -w server && npm run test:rules"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
